label_v1: NEW EXPERIMENT — memescan audit v1, started November 25, 2026, paper only, not original evidence.
banner: Paper only. Not financial advice. No trading, no wallet.
why: Tests whether a rug/safety checklist actually separates memecoins that survive 24h from ones that collapse. Paper only, includes 1.5% slippage + fees per side. Most memecoins go to zero; expect negative results — the point is to measure the checklist, not to find trades.
why_v2: v2 (started November 25, 2026): CLEAN no longer blocked by checks the free data can't run; wider new-pair feed for more samples.
